message.content: In the conversation, Jareth speaks highly of the storytelling in the side quests of Red Dead Redemption 2, particularly noting how the interactions at the camp can add more depth to the narrative and how these interactions can lead to unforgettable moments. Specifically, Jareth mentions that the campfire chats can create a cozy atmosphere and that these interactions can indeed add more depth to the story without changing the main plot. This indicates that Jareth praises Red Dead Redemption 2 for its engaging side quests and the ways in which they enhance the overall narrative experience.
